content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from nasaSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inAudio is mutednasaVerified•FollowOriginal audioMore optionsnasaVerified 2wYou can send your name around the Moon on our Artemis II mission—but time is running out! More than 5 million people have signed up to add their name (or a friend's, or a pet's, or a loved one's) to an SD card that will fly inside our Orion spacecraft when Artemis II lifts off in April. Visit the link in our bio, or go to go.nasa.gov/artemisnames, to add yours!
